pages.title: Shape It with Primordial Qi
pages.text: At the Smithing Table, place Spirit Core as template, Spirit Sword as base, and Primordial Qi as addition. The result keeps stage damage, Aura Repair, continuous tempering, and existing points.

pages.title: No Melee Growth from Tempering
pages.text: Its melee coefficient is fixed at 0% per point. Points remain visible in the tooltip and serve as phase-three beam fuel; ordinary slashes never multiply them into damage.

pages.title: Phase One
pages.text: Hold use for 5 ticks to fire a piercing 64-block beam. Entering costs 1 Immortal Yuan, then every 10 ticks the beam deals 20% attack damage to every living target on its path.

pages.title: Phases Two and Three
pages.text: At 25 ticks, spend 2 more Immortal Yuan and deal 20% every 5 ticks. Beyond 50 ticks, phase three deals 50% every 5 ticks and spends 10 tempering points for each beam.

pages.title: When the Stance Ends
pages.text: Sustained use stops when a phase lacks its required Yuan or tempering. Component refreshes do not replay lowering and raising; only a real slot or item change triggers re-equip.
